lines.zh: 我从土里钻出来，抖掉泥。
lines.en: I claw up out of the soil and shake off the dirt.

lines.zh: 岩石地上，我的小脚踩得急。
lines.en: My little feet patter quick over rocky ground.

lines.zh: 我弓着背，一颠一颠地跑。
lines.en: Hunched over, I jog in little bounces.

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓着碎石，很稳。
lines.en: My claws take the gravel firmly.

lines.zh: 我个子矮，从石缝里钻过去。
lines.en: I'm short; I slip through the rock gaps.
The leaf on my head bobs with each step.

lines.zh: 我沿着山脊的裂缝往前走。
lines.en: I work along the cracks in the ridge.

lines.zh: 我一步一跳，像颗弹在滚。
lines.en: I hop along like a rolling bead.
I follow a scent around an outcrop.
I kick loose stones behind me.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩石走，不喜欢空地。
lines.en: I hug the rock; I don't like open ground.
My shadow is too small to make out.
I crouch with my head tilted.
I scratch my belly.
My leaf turns to face another way.
I sniff the wind to count people.
I pant twice through my mouth.

lines.zh: 我把自己重新种进岩缝。
lines.en: I plant myself back into the rock crevice.
I stare at a bug in a rock gap.
I lean over, then straighten.
I can't decide which way to go.
My breathing is short and quick.

lines.zh: 我抬头看天，什么也没看懂。
lines.en: I look up at the sky and understand nothing.

lines.zh: 我在同一块石头上磨爪子。
lines.en: I sharpen my claws on the same stone.
I hop and land without a sound.
I wait for something I can fight.

lines.zh: 我从土里钻出来，绿油油的。
lines.en: I pop out of the soil, all green.
I'm looking at your ankles.
You have a smell. It's alive.
Are you my target?
I split my mouth open; that's not a smile.
You're standing very close. I don't mind.
I'm counting the joints in your legs.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，我只怕不够打。
lines.en: I'm not afraid of you; I just want a real fight.
I'm deciding where to start.
Hold still and let me look.
There's a gap at the edge of your armor.
Looking up at you makes my neck ache.
You haven't noticed me closing in.
I want one try. Just one.
You look solid.
My split fingers are moving.
I came to watch you fall.
I flip over backward.
It hurt enough to make me squeak.
I drop flat, then push up again.
Something yanked my leaf.
My blood is green; it spills everywhere.

lines.zh: 我抱着手臂，很快又松开。
lines.en: I clutch my arm, then let go.
I back half a step and bare my teeth.
That one made my head swim.

lines.zh: 我不怕疼，我只怕没打到。
lines.en: Pain doesn't scare me; missing does.
Food? I don't need it.

lines.zh: 那不是我长出来的东西。
lines.en: That's not what I grew from.
I'm not hungry; I just want to fight.
I sniff it and walk away.
You're wasting something good.

lines.zh: 我把爪子伸过去又缩回来。
lines.en: I reach a claw out, then pull it back.
Whether I eat or not makes no difference.
Don't try to trade that for me.
I know only soil and fighting.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我倒退了一截。
lines.en: You bump me and I skid back a stretch.

lines.zh: 我的爪子碰到你的靴子。
lines.en: My claws catch on your boot.
You knock me into a roll.

lines.zh: 我立刻爬起来，还站你面前。
lines.en: I scramble up and I'm in front of you again.
I stand pressed against your calf.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，我进了两步。
lines.en: You back one step; I take two.

lines.zh: 地面太窄，我们挤在一起。
lines.en: The ground's too narrow; we're pressed together.

lines.zh: 站稳，我的战斗力有一千二。
lines.en: Steady yourself. My power level is twelve hundred.

lines.zh: 我们是从同一个土坑里出来的。
lines.en: We came out of the same pit of soil.
Three or four of us stand abreast, crowded.

lines.zh: 我们互相拍了一下爪子。
lines.en: We clap claws once at each other.
It's a bit shorter than me.
We haul stones back and forth.
We don't talk, just stand abreast.
It charges first; I charge after.
We share the same patch of mud.

lines.zh: 叶片碰一下，就算打过招呼。
lines.en: Our leaves touch once, and that's hello.
We go watch the sunrise together.
A stone; heavy enough.
I shove what I found into my mouth.
I pick up a bone from the ground.
This shiny one is mine.
I claw the soil open.
I can't carry it, so I drag it.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的都是好东西。
lines.en: Anything dropped on the ground is a good find.

lines.zh: 绿色的小东西，举过头顶正好。
lines.en: This little green thing sits nicely on my head.
I hide it behind the rock.
I flatten down, ready to spring.
My claws are open.
I don't shout; I just charge.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖，是我第一个目标。
lines.en: Your knee is my first target.
I'm coming around your side.
My eyes lock on and don't let go.

lines.zh: 我听见你的脚步变重了。
lines.en: I hear your steps get heavier.
You can't get away; I'm fast.
I lower my head.
Right now; stop thinking.
I'm behind you.
Don't turn around; no time.

lines.zh: 岩石群系里，我从土里冒头。
lines.en: I pop out of the rocky soil.
This one I'll bite down on.
I follow low to the ground.
You hop onto a rock; so do I.
I'm faster than you'd think.
I don't stop, and I don't tire.
I cut through a gap in the rocks.
You circle; I circle.
I'm right at your heels the whole time.

lines.zh: 我闻着你留下来的味道。
lines.en: I follow the smell you leave.
I have no plan to give up.
You're slowing down.
The faster I run, the more excited I get.
You're looking for a way out; I'm blocking it.
My claws dig through the dirt.
You have a few steps left.

lines.zh: 栽培人的心跳，比你的响。
lines.en: A Saibaman's heart beats louder than yours.
Last warning: don't stop.
I rake my claws in.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，咬住你的袖子。
lines.en: I leap and bite your sleeve.
I slam into your calf.
My split fingers close and catch.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，但我知道位置。
lines.en: Not heavy, but now I know your weak spot.
I claw upward from below.

lines.zh: 我的爪子扣进你的肩膀。
lines.en: My claws dig into your shoulder.
You knock me away, and I run right back.
That swing comes with a fistful of dirt.

lines.zh: 你的护甲上多了几道痕。
lines.en: A few new scratches on your armor.
I dart around your feet.
I jump and claw at your waist.
I'm small, but my teeth are sharp.
You shouldn't have let me get close.
I squeeze out of a crack in the rocks.
The soil loosens and I stand up.
I shake the crumbly dirt off.

lines.zh: 这个地方石头很多，我喜欢。
lines.en: Lots of rocks here. I like it.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，第一件事是找目标。
lines.en: I open my eyes and look for a target first.

lines.zh: 我从土坑里爬出来，滑了一下。
lines.en: I climb out of the pit and slip once.
My leaf meets the wind for the first time.
This stony ground has me now.

lines.zh: 我从土里钻出，抖掉碎泥。
lines.en: I break out of the soil and shake off the dirt.
I spit out the dirt.

lines.zh: 我踩上石头，看了看四周。
lines.en: I climb a stone and look around.

lines.zh: 有人在这附近，我闻到了。
lines.en: Someone's nearby; I can smell them.
I'm here, and I'll start on this side.

lines.zh: 岩石地上的小影子，是我。
lines.en: The small shadow on the rocks is me.
I sharpen my claws while I wait.
I squint and pick out the distance.
Fire hits my hide and sizzles.

lines.zh: 我从岩石上滑下来，摔得闷。
lines.en: I slip off the rock and land hard.
Water fills my mouth and I kick wildly.
The blast throws me a long way.

lines.zh: 一粒东西打穿了我的手臂。
lines.en: Something small punches through my arm.
Light binds me and I can't move.
I should be back in the soil.

lines.zh: 雷打在我头上，我抽了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits my head and I spasm.
No soil here; my claws close on nothing.
